//: LOCAL DEVELOPMENT ONLY. Never mounted in any deployed environment.
appsettings.json takes the production posture: an R2 bucket is required of any role that
writes, and Garnet is enabled. That is correct there — a blank bucket produces a service
that reports perfect health for weeks while the sitemap silently ages — but it would make
`dotnet run` on a laptop impossible without Cloudflare credentials.
So this file switches off the external dependencies explicitly, for local work only. The
green path — reading the corpus, folding facet counts, writing and chunking the XML — needs
none of them and is what the test suites exercise.
